fields.comment: Information that can help fulfill an order

request.title: Order request
request.intro: Nothing is paid on the site: send the request, and the shop will contact you to confirm the order and agree on the payment.
request.loadError: The order could not be loaded. Please try again later.
request.empty: There is nothing in the cart that can be ordered.

contact.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +380 50 123 45 67

summary.deliveryNote: Delivery is not included: you pay the carrier on receipt (see the estimate in the delivery details).
summary.unavailableNote: Pieces that can no longer be ordered stay in the cart and are not part of this request.

errors.title: Please check the form
errors.lastName: The last name is too long.
errors.phone: Enter the phone number with the country code, for example +380501234567.
errors.delivery: Choose where to deliver the order.
errors.deliveryAddress: Press “Calculate delivery” to confirm the delivery address.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sorry, these pieces have just been ordered by someone else: {titles}. Nothing was sent. Remove them from the cart and send the request again.
errors.cartChanged: Your cart has changed in the meantime. Please check the order and send it again.
errors.emptyCart: There is nothing in the cart that can be ordered.
errors.pricesUnavailable: The prices cannot be calculated right now. Please try again later.
errors.unexpected: The request could not be sent. Please try again.

done.title: Order request sent
done.thanks: Thank you, {name}! Your order request has been received.
done.next: The shop will contact you to confirm the order and agree on the payment and the delivery. Payment is not taken on the site.
done.deliveryNote: You pay the actual delivery price to the carrier on receipt.
done.notAvailable: This order cannot be shown here.
done.notAvailableHint: Its confirmation opens only in the browser that sent the request, or when you are signed in to the account it was sent from.

search.unavailable: The search is not available right now. Please try again later.

method.label: How to receive the parcel
method.warehouse: At a branch or a parcel locker
method.addressUnavailable: Nova Poshta does not deliver to addresses in this place

quote.label: Delivery by Nova Poshta
quote.note: An estimate by the Nova Poshta tariff for a small box: you pay the actual price at the post office on receipt.
quote.noteOnReceipt: An estimate by the Nova Poshta tariff for a small box: you pay the actual price on receipt.
quote.unavailable: The price is not available right now: Nova Poshta calculates it on receipt.
quote.choose: Choose where to deliver to see the price

methods.division: To a Nova Post branch, parcel locker or pick-up point

internationalDelivery.courierOnly: Nova Post delivers to {country} by courier to the address.
internationalDelivery.loadError: The list could not be loaded. Please try again later.
internationalDelivery.noDivisions: There are no points of this type here.

address.changed: The address has changed: press “Calculate delivery” again.

quote.label: Delivery
quote.error: The delivery cost could not be calculated.
quote.estimateNote: A flat rate for the destination zone: you pay the actual price on receipt.
quote.tbdNote: The delivery rate for this zone has not been set yet.
quote.carrierNote: An estimate by the Nova Post tariff for a small box (10 × 10 × 5 cm): you pay the actual price on receipt.

internationalDelivery.customsNotice: Import VAT and customs duty may be payable by the recipient on delivery.
